overview: Semaphore = shared integer with atomic wait (P) and signal (V). Counting vs binary. GATE me: final semaphore value, mutual exclusion / ordering with semaphores, output of concurrent code, monitor with semaphores.
coreConcept: wait(s): s--, block if negative (or wait till s>0). signal(s): s++, wake a waiting process.
hinglishExplanation: Semaphore ek counter hai. wait matlab 'ek resource lo', signal matlab 'ek resource wapas do'. Final value = initial - (#wait) + (#signal), jab tak koi block na ho. Binary semaphore mutex jaisa kaam karta hai; ordering ke liye semaphore 0 se shuru karke signal/wait pair banao.
formalDefinition: wait(s): s--, block if negative (or wait till s>0). signal(s): s++, wake a waiting process.
importantProperties: Final value = initial - #wait + #signal (blocked processes ko alag se dekho).
Semaphore operations atomic hote hain (OS/hardware support se).
Deadlock ho sakta hai agar wait ka order alag ho.
Counting semaphore N resources ko manage karta hai.
Monitor condition variables semaphore se implement kar sakte hain.
commonPitfalls: Blocked wait ko complete maan lena.
Kaunse process pehle chalega ka interleaving ignore.
standardTechniques: Deadlock ke liye circular wait check.
Possible outputs ke liye interleavings enumerate.
